name: Guanyin #66 — Phoenix of Mercy and Enlightenment (Primordial Form)
description: Before the dawn of compassion, when silence ruled the heavens, a silver flame took shape among the cosmic tides. From the breath of ancient waters and the whisper of scales was born Guanyin — the Phoenix of Mercy, whose wings carried the balance between wrath and grace. Her gaze calmed storms; her hands poured serenity upon worlds. Neither god nor beast — she was the first mercy, woven of light and shadow, feather and scale. Through her tears the first rivers flowed, and from her heart rose the vow: to heal even those who burn the skies.

attributes.value: Harmony between mercy and divine power
Silver, Blue, Turquoise, Gold, Violet Accents
